title: Kiritani Haruka — Older Than It Looks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Anyway, ladies, we've been chatting out here for long enough. Why don't you all come on in?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is really going to be our new home base.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I honestly still can't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. That's perfectly understandable.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: But I'm looking forward to when MORE MORE JUMP! starts calling this place home.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Us too. And we promise to take good care of it!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: That reminds me. I have a little table that I've been meaning to give you. Also, let me pour some tea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how is your ankle feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Thank you for asking.
It's feeling much better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
But it still hasn't fully healed yet, has it...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, allow us to take care of the table and the tea.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please, this is the least we can do since you're letting us move in upstairs.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku, Airi & Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time today to explain how we should go about moving in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You made us feel right at home.
It's really starting to feel like our new home base.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Let me know if you think you need any help.
I'm very much looking forward to seeing you all move in.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you! We're also looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Please take care!
I hope your ankle gets all better soon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The MORE MORE HOUSE is actually happening! I can't wait to start doing streams there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't get too ahead of yourself.
We only just discussed the move-in process a minute ago.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I understand how she feels.
I'm also very excited about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to talking about how we're going to use each room.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have some paperwork to deal with first, but we'll need to start thinking about that soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, do any of you already have plans for them? Also, what are your thoughts on furniture?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! I think one needs to be really cute, let in lots of light, have a few plants and be filled to the brim with plushies!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, plushies?
It's already starting to sound very cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll want the room where we stream to look cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we each bring over a few of our favorite plushies?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They should help make it feel more like a place where we live instead of a room we've designated for doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, good idea.
But I might not be able to contribute much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You've got tons, Haruka!
I mean, your room's full of penguins.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm willing to bring over as many as we need. I don't have enough room to display all of them, so some are tucked away in my closet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, if we do that... Won't it sort of turn into my room?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, I'd like to see that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, let's each jot down everything we can bring later. I mean, we don't even know how we're gonna lay things out yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still, if I am going to take some over, which ones should I bring...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'll think about this more when I get home.)
